question: Deepa Malik is India's first female para-athlete to win a medal at the ______ Rio Paralympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __2016__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Deepa Malik created history at the Rio Paralympics by becoming the first Indian woman to win a medal in the history of the Games.
 
• With a personal best throw of 4.6
